system.description:
The Uchiha clan are masters of a highly agile form of combat known as the Agile Fist. This stance is treated as both a Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance because of its ability to integrate both unarmed and weapon based martial options into the flow of combat.

You can enter the Agile Fist stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 1d6 and the damage die of weapons you wield that are smaller than a d6, become d6.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for Unarmed and Weapon attack and damage

When you take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to use half of your AC, as your DR vs the triggering damage. If you reduce the damage by half or more, you can use Great Assault as part of the same reaction.

As an Action you can perform the Great Assault attack.

Great Assault. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack (60 Feet), using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, striking fast enough to fluster your foes, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, you can make a number of attacks with this ability equal to the number of attacks you can make with the Attack action.
